name: Wolverine
flavor: Mutation: Animal senses, healing factor, adamantium bones
notes: Wolverine is a man of many contradictions — a savage wild-man, with the discipline of a samurai warrior. A man with many lifetimes of experience and severe amnesia which hides his memories from him. The X-Men are his found family and he defends them fiercely.

powers.name: Been Around
powers.text: When you return to a place you've been before, or enter a dangerous place, make a skill roll and consult the table.

powers.name: Scout
powers.text: When you go ahead to scout, make a skill roll and consult the scout table.

powers.name: Streetwise
powers.text: Take Advantage on rolls to make underworld contacts or find resources.

attack_table_rider: Heal 1 HP on any roll of 3+; a roll of 2 grants only a Miss Token (no rider)

powers.name: Combat Stances
powers.effect: You know the three Stances below. Start combat in any one of them. Once/turn you may switch to a different stance. Each stance has an FX added to your Adamantium Claws attack, and a Passive applied while you are in it.

powers.name: Claw Frenzy Stance
powers.effect: FX: Deal 2✸ to one Enemy adjacent to the target.
powers.passive: Enemies who end their turn adjacent to you take 1✸.

powers.name: Weapon X Stance
powers.effect: FX: Deal Ongoing 1✸ (save ends) to the target.

powers.name: Samurai Stance
powers.effect: FX: You may slide the target by up to 2 squares.
powers.passive: You have Reach 2 (engaged with foes up to 2 squares away).

powers.name: Focused Attack
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, +1✸ to your attacks, and your Stances are enhanced — Claw Frenzy: 2✸ to all Enemies adjacent to the target; enemies that begin their turn adjacent to you, or move next to you, take 1✸. Weapon X: +2✸ Ongoing (save ends) to HTH attacks; +1✸ Ongoing (save ends) to your Opportunity attacks. Samurai: slide target up to 4 squares; you have Reach 3.

powers.name: Decapitation
powers.effect: Primary target must Save or be Taken Out. Other targets (if any) suffer +3✸.

powers.name: Healing Factor
powers.effect: Resist 1 (reduce all damage from each attack you suffer by one point). When you roll 3+ to attack, heal 1 HP. Make Saves vs Statuses at the start of your turn. Reduce Forced Movement by 1. When Slowed your speed is 3, instead of 2. If knocked Prone, you may Save to resist the FX.

powers.name: Murderer of Many Ninjas
powers.effect: Double your base damage for any HTH attack vs Mobs of Enemies. When you Take Out an enemy, apply leftover damage +1✸ to another Enemy in reach.

powers.name: Predator's Instincts
powers.effect: Trigger: When an enemy moves adjacent to you, they must stop moving. When an enemy grants you an Opportunity, +1✸.

powers.name: Adamantium Bones
powers.effect: Trigger: When an enemy hits you with an attack, spend 1 Action Point to ignore the FXs.

role_actions.name: Choose Your Enemies
role_actions.effect: Pick up to 2 Enemies in range as your marked targets. If they make an attack that doesn't include you or shift out of your reach, they grant you an Opportunity.

role_actions.name: "You're mine!"
role_actions.effect: Target has disadvantage on all attacks that don't target you. Lasts till you're Taken Out.

role_actions.name: Rally
role_actions.effect: Spend 1 Action Point: Heal 4 HP. Regain one Encounter power.
